details.description: Nous Hermes Llama2 13B is a 13-billion-parameter chat model that Nous Research fine-tuned from Meta's Llama 2 13B base. It was trained on more than 300,000 mostly GPT-4-generated synthetic instructions covering general chat, roleplay, and code, using an Alpaca-style prompt format. It is released as an open-weight model under the MIT license.
advantages: Its model card reports it ranked first among compared models on the ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, and OpenBookQA benchmarks.
Scores a 70.0 average on the GPT4All benchmark suite, per its model card.
Its model card reports long responses, a lower hallucination rate, and no OpenAI-style censorship mechanisms in its training data.
disadvantages: English-language training data only, per its model card.
4,096-token training context, short next to more recent chat models.

notes: Only the Hugging Face model card was available; no separate maker docs page or host listing was found. BigBench and AGIEval scores were converted from the card's 0-1 fractions to a 0-100 scale.
